verdict.rationale: GitHub documents built-in CI/CD through GitHub Actions, which automates and executes workflows directly in the repository (github-docs-11, github-docs-38). Community users describe free CI/CD and, at the time, a lack of self-hosted runners for organizations, which implies jobs run on GitHub's own infrastructure (github-comm-19, github-comm-20). A user also reports Actions outages hitting their team weekly, which bears on how reliable the hosted runners are (github-comm-18). Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on GitHub-hosted runners (machine types, OS images, usage limits) and hands-on corroboration that no infrastructure management is needed.
